description: Ratio of selected-chain blocks to total DAG blocks created and merged across a recent window (2-20 blocks) on Kaspa, measuring DAG concurrency and block propagation density. Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_kaspa_chain_color when you need Blue vs red block counts in the merge sets of recent Kaspa; crypto_kaspa_dag_state when you need Kaspa BlockDAG snapshot: network name, block count, header. Price: $0.005 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

blocks.description: Number of selected-chain blocks to inspect (default 5, min 2, max 20).
